scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare: the DFT energies are the headline quantities; recompute-from-raw is infeasible because only the final summary CSV is submitted. Hidden gold from the paper is compared with a symmetric tolerance window.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference binding energies (Sn on Zn facets, Zn on Zn/Sn facets) and surface energies for Zn(002), Zn(100), Zn(101), Sn(200), Sn(101) from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from Fig. 1k, Fig. 2a, Fig. 2d and main text of Adv. Mater. 2024, 36, 2308684.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription of reported DFT values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper’s own published DFT results, required to verify reproduction of the computational claim.

outputs.description: Table of DFT‑computed binding and surface energies for the five facets. The checker reads each row and compares the reported energies to reference values within per‑quantity tolerances appropriate for PBE plane‑wave DFT.

output_contract.notes: The agent must use the standard bulk lattice constants for Zn (hcp, a=2.665 Å, c=4.947 Å) and Sn (tetragonal, a=5.832 Å, c=3.181 Å). The binding_energy_Sn_on_Zn column should be left empty for Sn facets. All energies must be reported in the units specified above.
